# function: codeartifact_package

Builds the ARN of an `codeartifact` `package`:

```
arn:${Partition}:codeartifact:${Region}:${Account}:package/${DomainName}/${RepositoryName}/${PackageFormat}/${PackageNamespace}/${PackageName}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
codeartifact_package(domain_name string, repository_name string, package_format string, package_namespace string, package_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `domain_name` (String) Value for `${DomainName}` in the ARN template.
1. `repository_name` (String) Value for `${RepositoryName}` in the ARN template.
1. `package_format` (String) Value for `${PackageFormat}` in the ARN template.
1. `package_namespace` (String) Value for `${PackageNamespace}` in the ARN template.
1. `package_name` (String) Value for `${PackageName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
